name: @latticekit/showcase-emberwake
description: EMBERWAKE — a fast isometric night raid built only from @latticekit/*. The flagship showcase: what the kit can do with no line limit.
$comment: Not a workspace member on purpose: showcase/ is outside the root package.json's workspaces globs, so this folder installs nothing and resolves @latticekit/* through the repository's own node_modules — the same dist symlinks every exhibit uses. Run `npm run build` at the root first.
